text: dutiyakassapasuttaṃ [223] sāvatthiyaṃ ārāme ... ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho kassapoṭa devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi #1 sī. anusāsanintipi anusāsinintipi pāṭho . bhikkhu siyā jhāyi vimuttacitto ākaṅkhe ve 1 hadayassānupattiṃ lokassa ñatvā udayabyañca sucetaso anissito 2 tadānisaṃ soti . tatiyaṃ
